etymologies.heading: Etymology
paragraphs: Borrowed from Ancient Greek ἀκμή (akmḗ, “point; high point”).
senses: A high point: the highest point of any range, the most developed stage of any process, or the culmination of any field or historical period. [c. 1610]
A paragon: a person or thing representing such a high point. [c. 1610]
